book.name: Matai
book.title: Uruunu ambaiŋana ki Yesu Krisi ta Matai ibeede

content: Tere waende bizin kembei wal sananŋan pepe
“Kere waeyom bizin mi loŋa koso zin sananŋan pepe. Kokena Anutu ire yom tomini kembei wal sananŋoyom.
Pa niom sombe loŋa mi koso zin sananŋan, inako Anutu iso piom ta kembei tomini. Pa mbulu ta so kakam pizin tomtom, ta ko imiili piom tomini.
Re. Ke pakaana biibi ta imbot la motom na, yamaana som? Kena parei ta loŋa kwom ila pa ke tipiini ri ta imbot la toŋmatiziŋ ku mataana na,
mi so pini: ‘A barau, ke tipiini ri ta imbot la motom na, nio aŋsombe aŋuulu u mi aŋpai ma isu lene.’
Ina nu kam pakaamŋana! Pai nu ku ta biibi na ma isu muŋgu. Naso re kat tipiini ta imbot toŋmatiziŋ ku tana mataana na, mi rao pai ma isu lene.
“Koroŋ potomŋana na, kigiibi sorok pizin me pepe. Mi koroŋ tiom ambaimbaiŋan na, kipiri su pizin ŋge pepe. Kokena tikelut ma isaana, mi timaŋga piom tomini.
Kusuŋ, kuru, mi kutut kataama
“Niom koso kiwi, to kakam. Kuru, to kendeeŋe. Kutut kataama, to kataama ikaaga piom.
Pa tomtom ta so iwi, nako ikam. Mi tomtom ta so iru, nako indeeŋe. Mi tomtom ta so itut kataama, nako kataama ikaaga pini.
“Parei, sombe pikin tasa iwi tamaana pa ka kini, ko tamaana ikam ka pat? Som.
Mi sombe iso pa ka ye, ko ikam ka mooto sananŋana? Som.

Lak, niom na sananŋoyom. Tamen kakamam koroŋ ambaimbaiŋan men pa lutuyom bizin. Mi Tomoyom ta imbotmbot saamba a, kampeŋana kini ilip kat piom. Tana wal ta so tisuŋi, na ni ko ikam koroŋ ambaimbaiŋan kat pizin.
Mbulu ta so leleyom be tomtom tikam piom, na niom kupumuuŋgu pizin. Pa tutu ki Anutu mi sua kizin Anutu kwoono bizin, ka uunu ŋonoono ta tiŋgi.
Zaala ru
“Kelela siiri kwoono ta musaana na. Pa zin wal tabe tila len i, na siiri kwoono ta zin tilela pa i, na biibi. Mi zaala ta tito na, imarra pizin. Tabe tomtom boozomen lelen pa zaala tana.
Mi zaala tabe tomtom tito ma tikam mbotŋana mata yaryaaraŋana pa i, na kwoono musaari, mi ipata pizin be tito. Tabe wal rimen ta tindeeŋe mi tito.
Mbulu kizin wal pakamkaamŋan ko iswe zin
“Kere yom! Pa wal pakamkaamŋan ta tiso zin Merere kwoono bizin, kola timar tipet tiom. Zin sombe timar na, mbulu kizin mat kana ko kembei ta sipsip. Mi lelen na, kembei me saŋsaŋŋan ta malmalŋan i.
Tamen niom ko karao be kikilaala zin. Pa mbulu mi uraata kizin ko iswe zin piom. Parei, ko worwooro sananŋan tipiyooto ŋonoono ambaiŋana sa be teke mi takan? Som.
Mi ke ta kembena. Sombe ambaiŋana, nako ipiyotyooto ŋonoono ambaimbaiŋan men. Mi ke sananŋana, ina ipiyotyooto ŋonoono sananŋan men.
Tana ke sananŋana ko irao ipiyooto ŋonoono ambaiŋana sa na som. Mi ke ambaiŋana ko irao ipiyooto ŋonoono sananŋana sa na som.
Mi ke boozomen ta so tipiyotyooto ŋonon ambaimbaiŋan som, inako titaara ma tisu len, mi tipiri sala you ikan.
Tana mbulu mi uraata ta zin wal pakamkaamŋan tipiyotyooto, ta ko iswe zin piom.
Tapaata sorok Yesu be Merere kiti pepe
“Zin wal ta tiwatwaata yo be ‘Merere kizin’, inako timap ma tilela kar saamba som. Pa zin wal tau titoto Tamaŋ Anutu ta imbot saamba na leleene, mi tikamam ka mbulu na, zin men ta ko tilela.

Tana mbeŋ kaimer iso ipet, na wal boozo ko timaŋga mi tiso ta kembei: ‘O Merere, muŋgu niam amkam uraata boozomen pa nu zom. Amwe kwom mi amzzo kalŋom pizin tomtom. Mi amzirziiri bubuŋana sananŋan pizin tomtom, mi amtortooro mos boozo ma ipet tomini.’
Tamen nio ko aŋso kat pizin ta kembei: ‘Nio aŋute yom risa som. Kala leyom! Pa niom wal sananŋoyom.’
Tomtom ru tipo ruumu
“Tana wal ta so tileŋleŋ la sua tio ti, mi titoto, ina zin kembei ta tomtom ŋgarŋana ta ipo ruumu mbolŋana isala raŋ.
Beso yaŋ mosoolo isu ma wo ipet mi miiri biibi imar ma itok ruumu tana, na irao imuzu na som. Pa raŋ ipombol ruumu ma imbol kat.
Mi wal ta so tileŋleŋ sorok kalŋoŋ, mi titoto som, ina zin kembei ta tomtom talliŋana ta ipo ruumu kini sala lele magargaaraŋana.
Beso yaŋ mosoolo isu ma wo ipet, mi miiri biibi itok ruumu tana, na loŋa men mi imuzu ma isu lene, mi ka mburu ta boozomen porokporok ma imap.”
Yesu iposop sua kini ma imap, to zin iwal ta tileŋleŋi na, timurur pa ŋgar kini.
Pa ni ikamam sua kembei ta zin ŋgarŋan ki tutu na som. Ni izzo katkat sua raama mburaana, kembei tomtom ta zaana pa uraata kini.
